study_question: Do deterministic per-session CUSUM+SMA candidates on SPY, labeled by the F1 gated triple-barrier labeler, show positive net economic expectancy in any preregistered barrier cell, after multiplicity (Holm + DSR n_trials=175), cost stress, and a sign-shuffle placebo?

explicitly_not.not_an_admission_packet: SURVIVE_ECONOMIC is not decision-path admission. Admission requires operator sign-off and the CR admission registry.
explicitly_not.not_production_wiring: Report-only. No production columns, no serving changes.
explicitly_not.not_a_meta_model_study: The meta-classifier trains under META_XGB_TB_INGEST_V1 in a separate preregistered study.

data.bars: price_bars_1m canonical via load_spy_1m_bars (RTH clock filter) then time_et.is_tradable_session_ts_utc (weekday+calendar+minutes)
data.bar_source_gate: f1_input_gates: known-real membership only; synthetic AND unknown withhold
data.tier_note: SPY only per Framework Step 8; QQQ requires its own prereg

candidate_generator.per_session_reset: generator sees ONE ET session at a time; overnight gaps cannot trigger events
candidate_generator.no_tuning: parameters frozen; changing after seeing results voids the run

labeling.atr: Wilder-14 anchored at T-1 (LOCKED framework item; not a grid axis)
labeling.force_flat: session close minus 5 min via S1 calendar authority

primary_metric.name: mean net expectancy per candidate (bp, post-cost), session-blocked
per_cell_screen: session-block bootstrap 95% CI of mean_net_bp excludes 0 (B=1000)
Holm-adjusted bootstrap p < 0.05 across the 175-cell family
DSR: probabilistic Sharpe of per-session means vs expected-max-SR under n_trials=175 >= 0.95
2x-cost stress: CI still excludes 0 at round_trip_bp * 2
per-cell sign-shuffle null: observed mean above null q97.5 (K=200)
primary_metric.anti_signal_rule: CI entirely below 0 AND Holm-significant => STOP_ANTI_SIGNAL flag on the study (defect finding, never a quiet KILL)

placebo.definition: full-grid replicate with each cell's candidate net returns SIGN-SHUFFLED (seeded, per cell); the replicate runs the identical verdict pipeline
placebo.hard_halt: any placebo-grid SURVIVE_ECONOMIC => study status HALT_PLACEBO_EDGE; no real survivors may be reported

audit.two_way: both agents run the acceptance command before any survivor claim
